This release is (hopefully) our last minor release before extendr v1.0.0. This release is focused almost entirely on improved developer experience. 

- this release has been expedited due to the non-API changes from R-cores C API stabilization

Read the full [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/extendr/extendr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).



## TL;DR


- moving towards semver
- `rextendr::document()` is deprecated
- Use any error type (e.g. `anyhow::Error`)
- `Result` has been removed from the prelude
- use From/TryFrom

## A note on semantic versioning

The Rust ecosystem encourages the use of [**semantic versioning**](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/semver.html) (SemVer) to keep expectations managed.

To oversimplify: any time something in your crate's API changes, is removed, or otherwise requires changing the users behavior, that requires a **major** version increment. If a feature is added, that requires a **minor** version increment. If a bug is fixed that is a **patch** version increment.

All too often in the rust ecosystem a minor or patch version  introduces breaking changes. We want to practice what we preach and follow SemVer to the best of our abilities. 

You can expect the next time that there is a breaking change, that there will be a major version bump! That doesn't mean it is an entirely new crate or anything. 

## CRAN & non-API Entrypoints

- we have to be reactive to changes from R core on removal of C API usage
- v0.8.0 was replaced libR-sys with extendr-ffi which contains hand curated bindings to R's C API
- as changes are made to the C api we are addressing them in the main branch and adding [**backports**](link to definition somewhere)
- we want your extendr-powered packages to be as stable as we can make them to this end, we create backports to ensure that upgrading extendr doesn't mean your R packages need to depend on R 4.6+

Backports are defined at https://github.com/extendr/extendr/blob/main/extendr-ffi/src/backports.rs

if you encounter a note or a warning, please create an issue or mention it on our discord if we havent addressed it yet! its tough business!
